name: io.github.SokolskyNikita/annas-mcp
title: Anna's Archive and OpenAlex
description: Find books, papers and dissertations with Anna's Archive and OpenAlex, then download or read them.

environmentVariables.name: ANNAS_SECRET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Anna's Archive secret key for books, archive searches and archive downloads.

environmentVariables.name: OPENALEX_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional OpenAlex API key for papers, dissertations, open PDFs and structured full text.

environmentVariables.name: ANNAS_DOWNLOAD_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Folder for downloaded files. Defaults to annas-archive in your home folder.

environmentVariables.name: ANNAS_ACCOUNT_COOKIE
environmentVariables.description: Optional aa_account_id2 cookie from a signed-in browser, for when signing in with the secret key fails.
